Hi Sarah — thanks for the quick note and the screenshot.

A couple of quick asks while we investigate:
- Can you confirm the exact email address you used when accepting the invite? You mentioned billing@pioneercrates.com but sometimes users accept with a personal alias and that creates a separate portal identity.
- Can you share the organization id shown in the selector (if you hover it or click 'Manage organizations' — the id is a short hex at the end)?

Workarounds we can try now:
1) Open an incognito/private window and accept the invite link again (this bypasses stale cookies).
2) If you still don't see POs, reply with the PO numbers and we can surface PDFs manually from our side while we sort tenant mapping.

Looping in Laura (CS) to help with immediate visibility and Ben (ops) to look at the SSO mapping.

-Jordan

I attached a closer screenshot of the selector and the console captured an "403 tenant_alias_mismatch" briefly when switching orgs.

Please advise next steps. We have shipment scheduled and need PO 4321 confirmed.

—Sarah

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Portal access - where are our POs? (diagnostics attached)

Looping in with quick diagnostics. I pulled the SSO handshake and the session cookie details for Sarah's account — attaching sso-trace-20261110.txt. Root cause appears to be a tenant-alias collision during invite reconciliation: Pioneer Crates is correctly provisioned, but an older tenant alias (org_test123) shares a close email alias; when the UI renders the org selector the client-side code picks the first match and the backend returns an empty PO index for that alias.

Short term fixes:
- Ask vendor to clear cookies or use incognito (we pushed an update that will roll later this week to prefer explicit org ids).
- If that fails, we can bind the billing@ email to the Pioneer Crates tenant explicitly via the admin API (manual rebind). I can do that if you authorize it.

I've opened internal ticket OPR-2119 and linked the trace. ETA for a code fix is 48-72 hours; manual rebind should be <30 min.

Attachment: sso-trace-20261110.txt

Ben Carter

Sarah — thanks for the info and the screenshot. Ben's trace shows the alias collision; apologies for the friction. Two options:

1) Quick (recommended): Please try an incognito/private window and sign in with billing@pioneercrates.com. If you still see the empty list, tell me and we will manually surface PO 4321/4322 as PDFs to your inbox within 30 minutes.

2) Definitive (we can do this now with your approval): I can authorize Ben to manually rebind billing@pioneercrates.com to the Pioneer Crates tenant (admin rebind). This will resolve the alias collision immediately and prevent future selector confusion. It requires confirmation from the Pioneer Crates billing contact.

If you authorize the rebind, reply with "AUTHORIZE REBIND" and we'll proceed (Ben will run the admin command and confirm when complete). Otherwise try option 1 and we'll push the PO PDFs so you can proceed with shipment.
